name: Work and Residence Permit (Companies)

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must submit a letter of application on the applicant's behalf.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Ghana-registered employer willing to sponsor the application.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must hold business registration certificates and tax clearance.
Medical report from the Ghana Immigration Service clinic and a police report from the applicant's home country are required.
